title: 参数量估算器：embedding+attention+FFN 各占比
code:
d_model = 4096
n_layers = 32
vocab = 32000
emb = vocab * d_model
attn_per_layer = 4 * d_model * d_model
ffn_hidden = 4 * d_model
ffn_per_layer = 2 * (d_model * ffn_hidden)
ln_per_layer = 2 * 2 * d_model
total_attn = n_layers * attn_per_layer
total_ffn = n_layers * ffn_per_layer
total_ln = n_layers * ln_per_layer
total = emb + total_attn + total_ffn + total_ln
print("词嵌入参数量:", emb)
print("注意力(每层4投影) 总:", total_attn)
print("FFN(每层) 总:", total_ffn)
print("LayerNorm(每层) 总:", total_ln)
print("总参数量:", total)
print("折合 B:", round(total / 1e9, 3))
print("FFN 占比约:", round(total_ffn / total * 100, 1), "%")
